audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of five full events: Leo’s island history and identity scenes, the sewer peace agreement, and Caroline’s sunroom scene. Every quoted line, question, choice, and branch response was reviewed in context; Leo’s childlike broken syntax, canonical Golden Walnut, Shadow People, Elemental Wars and Sewers terminology, speaker voice, and forms of address were checked. Event commands, actors, movement, timings, mail and friendship conditions, music and sound IDs, branch delimiters, response counts, placeholders, emotes, escaped inner quotation marks, and non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. The full-locale final audits remain pending.

Я доклала багато зусиль, щоб зробити її такою...$h"(break)pause 100\speak Caroline "Так... Щойно я сюди заходжу, то одразу відчуваю спокій і розслаблення. Це справді цілюще!"(break)pause 100\speak Caroline "О? А мене це тепло заспокоює.$s#$b#Якщо не рухатися, стає приємніше."(break)emote Caroline 16\pause 100\speak Caroline "О, але ж ти професійно цим займаєшся...
